description: Per-pool DeFi yield-entry go/no-go. Pass a DefiLlama poolId (the 'pool' field from defi_yields) and get a packaged SUSTAINABLE | DECAYING | OUTLIER | AVOID verdict + 0-100 risk score + field-cited reasons, built from the pool's APY trend (1d/7d/30d), DefiLlama stability forecast, impermanent loss (il7d), volatility (sigma), outlier flag and TVL. Optional token (0x underlying, Base) adds a honeypot-check pointer. The should-I-enter-THIS-pool call after defi_yields. Cost: $0.01 USDC per call via x402.

pool.description: DefiLlama poolId — the 'pool' field from defi_yields (required)

token.description: Optional underlying token (0x, Base) — adds a honeypot-check pointer

name: yield_entry_verdict
